owl.name: A guide's first lesson
owl.helpZh: 在战斗中累计答对5道题。

fox.name: Well-prepared paws
fox.help: Buy 2 potions of either kind at the village shop.
fox.helpZh: 在村庄商店累计购买2瓶治疗或提示药水。

cat.name: A curious scholar
cat.help: Answer 10 different questions correctly on your first attempt.
cat.helpZh: 累计10道不同题目首次作答正确。

dragon.name: Courage in the ruins
dragon.help: Win 2 battles in the Ancient Ruins.
dragon.helpZh: 在古代遗迹累计赢得2场战斗。

wisp.name: A light remembered
wisp.help: Master 1 memory rune with spaced reviews.
wisp.helpZh: 通过间隔复习掌握1枚记忆符文。

bunny.name: A message of hope
bunny.help: Finish the elder and Mira's story chapters.
bunny.helpZh: 完成长老与米拉的两段主线剧情。

slime.name: A careful recovery
slime.help: Use an owned healing potion during a battle.
slime.helpZh: 在战斗中使用1瓶已拥有的治疗药水。

penguin.name: Stand your ground
penguin.helpZh: 在战斗中为2道题准备防御。

turtle.name: Patience and grammar
turtle.help: Answer 5 grammar questions correctly in battle.
turtle.helpZh: 在战斗中累计答对5道语法题。

bat.name: Listen to the echoes
bat.help: Defeat 1 guardian inside a cave or tower.
bat.helpZh: 击败1只洞穴或高塔内部的守卫。
